content: {"assumptions": ["Total walking robot mass ~1.5 kg including MeArm arm, battery and electronics, typical for MG90S quadruped", "Multipart leg dynamics lumped into single forward-velocity first-order lag with tau ~0.6 s from gait cycle and servo speed", "Arm held fixed during walking and treated as rigid payload, lifts ~100 g only", "Linearised around slow forward walk on flat floor, no slip, no running or jumping", "Loop update and gait generation delay ~0.08 s lumped as pure dead time", "Actuator modeled as averaged leg thrust voltage -5 to 5 V from 5 V UBEC system, saturation handled by controller anti-windup"], "controller": {"N": 12.0, "Q": [], "R": 1.0, "kd": 8.0, "ki": 2.5, "kp": 15.0, "type": "pid"}, "controllerRationale": "Position plant contains a free integrator so PID gives zero steady error to step reference.
